crossRefs.note: Thus God has taken away your father’s livestock, and given them to me.
The cedars in the garden of God could not hide it. The cypress trees were not like its boughs. The pine trees were not…

people.name: Israel
people.line: Patriarch, son of Isaac, father of twelve tribes

translations.web: Jacob took to himself rods of fresh poplar, almond, and plane tree, peeled white streaks in them, and made the white appear which was in the rods.
translations.bsb: Jacob, however, took fresh branches of poplar, almond, and plane trees, and peeled the bark, exposing the white inner wood of the branches.
translations.kjv: And Jacob took him rods of green poplar, and of the hazel and chesnut tree; and pilled white strakes in them, and made the white appear which was in the rods.
translations.asv: And Jacob took him rods of fresh poplar, and of the almond and of the plane-tree. And peeled white streaks in them, and made the white appear which was in the rods.
